free_tier.stated: Not published. What is documented is capability rather than quota: the dataset center accepts file, folder, or archive uploads and auto-extracts archives server-side; public datasets require a license field before they can be published (so publishing is a two-step publish flow, not a raw PUT). OpenDataLab is the org behind the WanJuan corpus and mirrors COCO and similar multi-hundred-GB sets, so its scale class is genuinely multi-TB on the read side.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Free for public datasets; anonymous downloads. No egress line found. Served from Chinese CDN endpoints.

tooling: Same openxlab toolchain (OpenDataLab runs on the OpenXLab 浦源 docs stack): `pip install openxlab`, `openxlab dataset upload-file/-folder`. Also opendatalab/opendatalab-python-sdk (60 stars) and an OpenDataLab CLI documented at opendatalab.com/docs/developers/数据集/数据集CLI. There is no S3 API.
chaining: Per-dataset repos, unlimited count, free account. 50 GB-class datasets are the platform's normal unit, so N datasets x 50-200 GB.

extras.agent_focus: New and up-and-coming competitors to Hugging Face and ModelScope, judged on the hard test the brief sets: a credible HF competitor must permit multi-TB objects and generous per-account storage, because model weights and datasets routinely run to hundreds of GB / TiB. Split into three classes — Chinese domestic hubs (HF is blocked there, so a separate ecosystem exists), Western MLOps artifact stores (W&B/Comet/ClearML/Lightning/Deep Lake), and dataset-publishing startups (Source Cooperative, Oxen, OpenDataLab). Excluded and not re-reported: Hugging Face, ModelScope, Kaggle, Civitai, Ollama, Replicate, DagsHub, OpenML, fal.ai, Baseten, Modal.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
